Game Overview

At its heart, Highway Driver 3D is a driving game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Highway Driver 3D is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Highway Driver 3D?

Highway Driver 3D is a free driving game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Highway Driver 3D free to play?

Yes, Highway Driver 3D is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
